subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 1: Reading – the future of entertainment
outcomes: Skim-read an article to find its main topics quickly.
Choose sentences that fit gaps using linking and reference words.
Learn new words like transform, lifelike and version.

tf.s: Skim-reading means reading quickly to find the main ideas.
tf.why: You don't need to read every word.

tf.s: One skimming method is to read the first one or two lines of each paragraph.
tf.why: The first lines often show the main idea.

tf.s: In a gapped text, every extra sentence fits somewhere.
tf.why: Extra sentences don't fit any gap.

tf.s: In some interactive content, viewers can choose between different endings.
The article says some people worry AI could replace human jobs in entertainment.
tf.why: This is one worry about AI.

tf.s: In 'Robot doctors', the writer wants to stop seeing her doctor now.
tf.why: She wants to keep seeing her doctor for now.

tf.s: The tiny robots in 'Robot doctors' move through our blood.
tf.why: That is why they must be very small.

boxes.q: In gap 3, 'Such characters' refers back to…
boxes.why: Reference words point back to an earlier idea.

boxes.q: Complete: I prefer the original v___ of that story.
boxes.why: A version is one form of something.

boxes.q: Complete: Small toys can be dangerous for babies – they might ___ them.
What is the main idea of 'Robot doctors'?
boxes.why: The article is about the future of doctors.

boxes.q: Complete: I don't ___ that man. He doesn't always tell the truth.
boxes.why: We don't trust people who don't tell the truth.

boxes.q: How can AI change a film for different viewers?
o: to make it the same for all
boxes.why: AI can change the style or story for each viewer.

boxes.q: A doctor who knows a lot about one area is a…
boxes.why: A specialist is an expert in one area.

hunt.q: Care given to make you better
Extra sentences in the gapped text

mcq.q: Which skimming method does the study tip suggest?
o: Pick out key verbs and nouns quickly
mcq.why: Key words help you skim fast.

mcq.q: What does 'consume' mean when we talk about entertainment?
o: use or take in films and content
mcq.why: We consume content when we watch, read or listen.

mcq.q: Which word means 'what you like more than other things'?
mcq.why: Your preference is what you prefer.

mcq.q: Which topic does the article mention?
mcq.why: AI can help people make their own films.

mcq.q: Complete: It's important to practise r___ if you want to speak English well.
The sentence before a gap talks about AI recommending movies. Which sentence will fit best?
o: One that continues the idea of AI in film
One that starts a new topic about sport
mcq.why: The right sentence links to what comes before and after.

mcq.q: Complete: The new game has very ___ characters – they look real!
Why doesn't sentence B fit the article?
o: It is negative, but the article is mostly positive about AI.
mcq.why: The tone of the sentence must match the text.

mcq.q: Which is a positive effect of AI on entertainment, according to the article?
o: You can make your own films easily.
mcq.why: Making your own films easily is a positive change.

mcq.q: Does the writer of 'Robot doctors' believe robots will be better than her usual doctor?
o: No – she wants to keep seeing her doctor for now.
Yes – she has stopped visiting doctors.
mcq.why: She still wants to see her own doctor.
